seed: Objects of type `arm` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [block,block,block,block,player] show mixed outcomes: pixels,w x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Ring (player) + beam (arm) move by 6 on a rail; on-beam blocks (any tag) carried; moved rects push blocks in a chain.
A1/A2 cancel if any block/ring would leave the colour-4 field; A4/A3 change beam w by 6 within [1, field width].
Arm A4 mixed outcome = no object field: no_change when the beam is already at max width / dragged group blocked by the field edge (beam alone otherwise).
Tags: hooked next (x == tip-5) with all other on-beam blocks collected -> collected; collected off beam reverts to next.
HUD row 3s = (n-1)//3 with n = non-click actions, remembered per returned frame (fallback 3*threes+1). A5/A7 unobserved.
